purpose: Rights register for the editorial V12.1 derivative of the project-owned V12 dataset.

review.decision_evidence: The rights holder previously confirmed that V12 belongs to the project, contains no real personal data, and permits training and derivative-weight distribution. In this task the holder approved manual editorial corrections and explicitly requested version V12.1. This register inherits that V12 authorization for the corrected derivative and project-authored fictional focused examples; it does not assert that V12.1 training has run. No data generator was run.

records.source_reference: workspace:docs/calendar_sft_data_provenance_v12.json; exact V12 source hashes are locked in docs/calendar_assistant_v12_1_editorial.json
records.rights_evidence: The VERIFIED V12 register covers the inherited sources. Only approved editorial changes are applied; original parameters and non-creation answers remain unchanged.
24 handwritten fictional calendar cases authored in the project for the approved V12.1 editorial correction, with no external data or real personal information.
